# CLAUDE.md — B2B commerce app on Vendure

This file is loaded into every Claude Code session in this repo. It tells you (Claude) how this
project is built, how to look things up, and the rules you must follow when changing it.
Detailed step-by-step recipes live in the **`vendure-plugin-dev` skill**
(`.claude/skills/vendure-plugin-dev/`). **Load that skill before any task that touches
`src/plugins/`, `vendure-config.ts`, custom fields, the GraphQL API, migrations, or the admin
Dashboard.**

## 0. Paths in this repo

This is a monorepo. **All Vendure paths in this file and in the skill (`src/…`,
`vite.config.mts`, `tsconfig*.json`) are relative to `backend/apps/server/`.**
Run `npx vendure …` commands from `backend/apps/server/` (where `src/vendure-config.ts` lives).
Run `npm install` only from `backend/` (npm workspaces root).

```
B2B-Aria-Maniadis/
├── CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json, .claude/skills/   ← Claude Code setup (open Claude Code HERE)
├── docker-compose.yml                       ← local Postgres 15 (+ Meilisearch, currently unused by Vendure)
└── backend/                                 ← npm workspaces root (package-lock.json, postinstall, patches/)
    ├── patches/@vendure+dashboard+3.7.3.patch
    ├── scripts/postinstall.js, scripts/setup-greek-translations.js
    ├── lingui.config.js
    └── apps/
        ├── server/       ← Vendure 3.7.3 (server + worker + Dashboard)
        └── storefront/   ← Next.js 16 / React 19 B2B storefront (gql.tada, Tailwind 4, Radix/shadcn)
```

## 1. Project facts

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| What the app is | B2B wholesale shop for **ARIA Bags & Hats** (Greek client): Vendure backend + admin Dashboard + Next.js storefront. Customers register with company + VAT number and can log in **only after an admin approves them** (no self-service email verification). |
| Vendure version (installed) | **3.7.3** (`@vendure/core`, `dashboard`, `cli`, `email-plugin`, `asset-server-plugin`, `graphiql-plugin` — all pinned exactly; upgraded from 3.5.3 in Sept 2026, see §11). `typeorm` is pinned in `backend/package.json` (root) so npm hoists a single copy — keep it equal to the version `@vendure/core` uses. Dashboard runs on Vite 7 / Base UI. |
| Package manager | **npm** workspaces (`backend/package-lock.json`). Never use pnpm/yarn/bun here. |
| Database | **PostgreSQL** (`pg`), via `docker-compose.yml` locally. Env: `DB_HOST/PORT/NAME/USERNAME/PASSWORD/SCHEMA`. |
| Node | Server Docker image uses `node:20`. |
| Admin UI | React **Dashboard** only (no legacy `AdminUiPlugin`), served by `DashboardPlugin` at `/dashboard`. Vite `api: { host: 'auto', port: 'auto' }`. Dashboard UI languages include **Greek (`el`)**. |
| Storefront | `backend/apps/storefront` — Next.js 16, dev port **3001**, deployed on Vercel. Talks to the Shop API. |
| Channels | Single default channel (as far as the code shows). |
| Assets | Local `static/assets` in dev; **Cloudflare R2 via S3** (`configureS3AssetStorage`) outside dev — needs `S3_*` env vars. |
| Search | `DefaultSearchPlugin` with custom `B2BPostgresSearchStrategy` (adds partial-SKU `ILIKE` matching). |
| Auth | `requireVerification: true`, bearer + cookie tokens, superadmin from `SUPERADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD` env. Shop login uses `ApprovalAwareNativeAuthenticationStrategy` (customer-approval plugin); the "verify your email" email is disabled. |
| Customer custom fields | `vatNumber`, `company` (in `vendure-config.ts`, editable by the customer in the storefront profile) and `approved` (readonly, admin-only, defined by the customer-approval plugin). |
| Payments | `dummyPaymentHandler` only (no real payment method yet). |
| Email | Dev: files + `/mailbox`. Elsewhere: SMTP when `SMTP_HOST` is set, otherwise no emails. Links use `STOREFRONT_URL`. Env vars typed in `src/environment.d.ts`. |
| Custom plugins (`src/plugins/`) | `csv-import` (upload → job queue on the **worker** → creates/updates products; permission `ImportProductsFromCsv`; Admin API `startCsvProductImport` / `csvProductImportJob`) · `customer-approval` (`Customer.approved` flag, `approveCustomer` / `revokeCustomerApproval` mutations, login gate, Dashboard button + bulk action) · `greek-translations` (Dashboard `el.po` + branded login page) · `translation-sync` (fills missing product/variant translations for all channel languages) · `search/b2b-search-strategy.ts` (not a plugin — a SearchStrategy). |
| Migrations | `src/migrations/` (Postgres). In **dev** (`APP_ENV=dev`) the server uses `synchronize: true` and does **not** run migrations; outside dev, `src/index.ts` runs `runMigrations` before bootstrap. `1790605810464-vendure-3-7-3-upgrade.ts` is the 3.5.3→3.7.3 upgrade (with the 3.6 data helpers); the first migration uses `IF NOT EXISTS` so it is safe on databases created by `synchronize`. |

## 2. How to look things up (in this order)

1. **The installed code is the source of truth for the version we run.**
   - Check versions (in `backend/`): `npm ls @vendure/core @vendure/dashboard typeorm`
     (`require('@vendure/dashboard/package.json')` doesn't work — the package has an exports map).
   - Server APIs: `node_modules/@vendure/core/dist/**/*.d.ts`.
   - Dashboard APIs: `@vendure/dashboard` ships its **source** — read
     `node_modules/@vendure/dashboard/src/lib/` to confirm an export or a prop exists before using it.
2. **Vendure docs MCP server** (configured in `.mcp.json` as `vendure-docs`): use `search_docs`
   to find pages and `get_doc_page` to read them in full.
3. **Docs as markdown over HTTP**: any docs page + `.md`, e.g.
   `https://docs.vendure.io/current/core/extending-the-dashboard/creating-pages/list-pages.md`.
   The full page index is `https://docs.vendure.io/llms.txt`.
4. The official changelog: `https://github.com/vendurehq/vendure/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md`.

> ⚠️ **The docs describe the latest release (3.7.x), not necessarily our installed version.**
> Many Dashboard APIs were added or changed in 3.6/3.7. Before using any API, check the
> **version gate table** in `.claude/skills/vendure-plugin-dev/references/version-notes.md`
> and confirm the export exists in `node_modules`. If a docs example doesn't compile, the
> version difference is the first suspect — don't "fix" it by importing library internals.

## 3. Mental model of a Vendure app

- **Vendure = NestJS + TypeORM + GraphQL (Apollo)**. Everything custom is a **plugin**
  (`@VendurePlugin`, a superset of a NestJS module).
- Two processes from the same codebase: the **server** (serves APIs) and the **worker** (runs
  job-queue jobs). Plugin lifecycle hooks run in **both** — guard with `ProcessContext` when
  something should run only once.
- Two GraphQL APIs: **Admin API** (`/admin-api`, used by the Dashboard) and **Shop API**
  (`/shop-api`, used by storefronts/B2B portals). Each is extended separately
  (`adminApiExtensions` / `shopApiExtensions`).
- The **Dashboard** is an npm package (`@vendure/dashboard`) that is **compiled inside this
  project by Vite**. The `vendureDashboardPlugin` in `vite.config.mts` reads
  `src/vendure-config.ts`, finds every plugin with a `dashboard: './dashboard/index.tsx'`
  property, compiles those extensions in, and introspects the Admin API schema (including our
  custom fields and API extensions) to generate types in `src/gql/`.
  **So: the Dashboard package is "closed" (never edit it), but it is fully extensible from our
  own plugins.** Every Dashboard change = a `dashboard/` folder inside a plugin +
  `defineDashboardExtension({...})`.

## 4. Server layout (`backend/apps/server/`) and plugin conventions

```
src/
  index.ts                 # dev: bootstrap only (synchronize); prod: runMigrations then bootstrap
  environment.d.ts         # typed process.env — add new env vars here
  index-worker.ts          # bootstrapWorker(config)
  vendure-config.ts        # THE config: plugins, custom fields, auth, db, strategies
  migrations/              # TypeORM migration files (generated, then reviewed)
  gql/                     # GENERATED by the Dashboard Vite plugin — never edit by hand
  plugins/
    <feature>/
      <feature>.plugin.ts  # @VendurePlugin(...) — the entry point
      constants.ts         # options token, loggerCtx, permission definitions
      types.ts             # plugin option types + custom-field typings (declare module)
      entities/            # TypeORM entities (extend VendureEntity)
      services/            # business logic (@Injectable)
      api/                 # api-extensions.ts (gql SDL) + *.resolver.ts
      config/              # strategies / configurable operations (payment, shipping, promotion…)
      dashboard/           # React Dashboard extensions (index.tsx = entry)
      e2e/                 # *.e2e-spec.ts tests
vite.config.mts            # Dashboard build (base '/dashboard', outDir dist/dashboard)
tsconfig.json              # server build — excludes dashboard code
tsconfig.dashboard.json    # dashboard extension type-checking (jsx, @/gql and @/vdb paths)
```

## 5. Commands

npm only. On **3.7.3** (current). `(backend)` = run in `backend/`, `(server)` = run in `backend/apps/server/`.

| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Local DB | `docker compose up -d` (repo root) |
| Install deps | `npm install` (backend) — runs `postinstall`: applies `patches/` and copies Greek translations into `node_modules/@vendure/dashboard` |
| Everything in dev (server + worker + Dashboard Vite + storefront) | `npm run dev` (backend) |
| Only Vendure (server + worker + Dashboard Vite) | `npm run dev:server` (backend) |
| Only storefront | `npm run dev:storefront` (backend) → http://localhost:3001 |
| Dashboard | http://localhost:3000/dashboard (Vite runs as `dev:dashboard`; restart the dev script after adding dashboard files) |
| Build server + Dashboard | `npm run build:server` (backend) = `tsc && vite build` |
| Type-check server | `npx tsc --noEmit` (server) |
| Type-check storefront | `npm run check-types -w storefront` (backend) |
| Lint / format | `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` (backend) |
| Scaffold (non-interactive) | `npx vendure add -p <Name>` · `-e <Entity> --selected-plugin <Plugin>` · `-s <Service> --selected-plugin <Plugin> [--type entity]` · `-a <Plugin> --queryName x --mutationName y` · `-j <Plugin> --name <job> --selected-service <Service>` · `-d <Plugin>` |
| Generate migration | `npx vendure migrate -g <kebab-name>` (server) — generate against a DB that matches **production's** schema (in dev, `synchronize` has already altered the local DB, so diff against a fresh/prod-like DB or the migration will come out empty) |
| Run pending migrations | `npx vendure migrate -r` (the server also runs them on start via `runMigrations`) |
| Revert last migration | `npx vendure migrate --revert` (ask the user first) |
| Dump schema for tooling | `npx vendure schema --api admin` (or `--api shop`) |
| Diagnose project | `npx vendure doctor` (server; needs DB env vars) · before deploy: `npx vendure doctor --profile production` |
| Help | `npx vendure add --help` (flag names changed between versions — check before using) |

3.7 also offers `npx vendure dev | build | start`; this repo keeps its own npm scripts
(`dev:server`/`dev:worker`/`dev:dashboard` via concurrently) — use those.

⚠️ **Never run an interactive CLI prompt.** Since 3.7 the `vendure` CLI fails fast when a flag
is missing in a non-interactive shell, but still pass every flag explicitly (and `< /dev/null`). Always pass every required flag. If a command
starts prompting anyway, stop it and scaffold by hand using the templates in the skill.

## 6. Golden rules (non-negotiable)

1. **Never edit `node_modules/`, never fork or patch `@vendure/dashboard` or `@vendure/core`.**
   Extend through plugins, strategies, custom fields, and `defineDashboardExtension`.
   (This repo has two legacy exceptions — `backend/patches/@vendure+dashboard+3.7.3.patch` and
   the Greek-translation copy in `postinstall`. Don't add new ones; see §12.)
2. **All custom code lives in a plugin** under `src/plugins/<feature>/`, registered in the
   `plugins` array of `src/vendure-config.ts`. One plugin per business capability.
3. **Prefer the CLI to scaffold** (`npx vendure add …`), because it also wires the plugin
   metadata and config. Then edit the generated files.
4. **Every schema change needs a migration**: new/changed entity, custom field, or relation →
   `npx vendure migrate -g <name>` → **read the generated SQL** → run it. Never set
   `synchronize: true` outside a throwaway local DB. MySQL/MariaDB migrations are **not
   transactional** — tell the user to back up first.
5. **`RequestContext` everywhere**: every service method takes `ctx: RequestContext` first;
   always use `this.connection.getRepository(ctx, Entity)` (never an injected raw repository);
   pass `ctx` to every Vendure service call.
6. **Every resolver method has `@Allow(...)`**; every mutation also has `@Transaction()`.
   Use custom permissions (`PermissionDefinition` / `CrudPermissionDefinition`) for new
   features and register them via `config.authOptions.customPermissions`.
7. **Channel isolation (critical for B2B)**: custom entities that belong to a customer/tenant must
   implement `ChannelAware` and be read with `connection.findOneInChannel(...)` /
   `listQueryBuilder.build(..., { ctx, channelId: ctx.channelId })`. Never return data from
   another channel. Treat "customer A can see customer B's data" as a severity-1 bug.
8. **No `process.env` inside plugins.** Read env vars in `vendure-config.ts` and pass them in
   via `MyPlugin.init({...})`; inject the options token in services.
9. **Job data must be serializable.** Never put a `RequestContext` in job data — use
   `ctx.serialize()` and `RequestContext.deserialize()`.
10. **Dashboard imports come from `@vendure/dashboard`** (UI components, hooks, TanStack
    Query/Router, React Hook Form, toast, …). Only exceptions: `react`, `lucide-react` (icons),
    `@lingui/react/macro`, and **`graphql` from `@/gql`** (never from `@vendure/dashboard`).
    Never import `@radix-ui/*`, `@base-ui/*`, `@tanstack/*`, `react-hook-form`, `sonner` directly.
    **This rule is for `apps/server/src/plugins/**/dashboard/` only** — the Next.js storefront
    (`apps/storefront`) is a separate app that legitimately uses Radix/shadcn, gql.tada, etc.
    `z` and `zodResolver` also come from `@vendure/dashboard`. Components use Base UI's
    **`render` prop** (e.g. `<Button render={<Link to="./new" />}>`), not Radix `asChild`.
11. **Do not use the legacy Angular Admin UI APIs** (`@vendure/ui-devkit`, `AdminUiPlugin`
    extensions, `addNavMenuItem`, `registerFormInputComponent`, anything under the docs'
    "legacy-apis" section) for new work.
12. **Never hand-edit `src/gql/`** — it is regenerated by the Vite plugin from the live schema.
13. **After adding a new file under a plugin's `dashboard/` folder, restart Vite** (`q`, then
    `npx vite`) — new files are not picked up by HMR.
14. **Ask before**: deleting data or migrations, reverting migrations, changing auth/session
    settings, changing money/tax/price calculation strategies, or upgrading `@vendure/*`.
15. **Money is an integer in minor units** (cents). Never use floats for prices.
16. **Greek first-class**: every new custom field, permission description, nav item and admin
    label gets both `LanguageCode.en` and `LanguageCode.el` labels where the API supports it;
    admin-facing Dashboard strings for this client may be Greek (existing `csv-import` page is).
17. **Storefront impact**: when a Shop API type changes, update the storefront's gql.tada
    queries in `apps/storefront` and run its type-check.

## 7. Standard workflow for every feature / change

1. **Clarify** the business rule in B2B terms (who: which role/customer group/channel; what data;
   which API — Admin, Shop, or both).
2. **Check the version gate** for any API you plan to use (skill → `version-notes.md`).
3. **Plan the pieces**: custom fields vs new entity · service · GraphQL schema + resolvers ·
   permissions · events/jobs · Dashboard UI · storefront impact · migration · tests.
4. **Scaffold with the CLI**, then implement (skill → `backend-recipes.md`).
5. **Migration**: generate, review SQL, run.
6. **Dashboard**: add/extend UI (skill → `dashboard-recipes.md`, IDs in `extension-targets.md`).
7. **Verify** (Definition of done below).
8. **Summarize** for the user: files changed, migration name, new permissions to assign to
   roles, and manual steps (restart Vite, run migration on staging, etc.).

## 8. Definition of done

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes for the server code.
- [ ] Dashboard extensions compile: `npx vite build` succeeds (Vite doesn't type-check — also
      check types in the IDE or with `npx tsc -p tsconfig.dashboard.json --noEmit` if the config allows).
- [ ] A migration exists for every schema change, and it was reviewed.
- [ ] Server boots without the "Your database schema does not match your current configuration" warning.
- [ ] New queries/mutations are protected by `@Allow`, mutations by `@Transaction`, and
      channel-scoped where the data is tenant-specific.
- [ ] E2E test added/updated for non-trivial backend logic (`@vendure/testing` + Vitest).
- [ ] New permissions listed for the user so they can assign them to Roles in the Dashboard.
- [ ] (≥ 3.7) `npx vendure doctor` passes.

## 9. B2B guidance (patterns to reach for — confirm with the user before choosing)

| Need | Vendure building block |
|---|---|
| Company accounts / segments / price lists | **CustomerGroups** (+ custom fields on `Customer`/`CustomerGroup`) |
| Per-customer or per-group prices | Custom `ProductVariantPriceCalculationStrategy` and/or `OrderItemPriceCalculationStrategy`, or group-restricted Promotions |
| Separate catalogs / currencies / tenants | **Channels** (+ `ChannelAware` custom entities); ≥ 3.7: `CustomerChannelAssignmentStrategy` to stop auto-joining channels |
| Quotes, approval flows, "pending approval" orders | Custom `OrderProcess` states + an `OrderPlacedStrategy`, or a custom `Quote` entity plugin |
| Invoice / net-30 payment terms | Custom `PaymentMethodHandler` (+ `PaymentMethodEligibilityChecker` limited to trusted groups) |
| No guest checkout | `orderOptions.guestCheckoutStrategy` (`DefaultGuestCheckoutStrategy` with guests disabled) |
| Company-only fields on orders (PO number, cost center) | `Order` / `OrderLine` custom fields (OrderLine fields become args on `addItemToOrder`) |
| ERP / accounting integration | Plugin with job queue + `EventBus` subscribers; ≥ 3.6: **API keys** for machine access |
| Procurement punch-out | Community `PunchOutGatewayPlugin` |
| Hide internal fields from customers | Custom field `public: false`, `internal: true`, or `requiresPermission` |

## 10. Never do

- Edit `node_modules`, `dist/`, or `src/gql/` by hand.
- Use `synchronize: true` against any shared/staging/production database.
- Import dashboard UI primitives from third-party packages, or `graphql` from anywhere but `@/gql`.
- Leave a resolver without `@Allow`, or a mutation without `@Transaction`.
- Read `process.env` inside a plugin, or put `RequestContext` into job data.
- Return entities from another channel, or skip channel scoping on tenant data.
- Copy code from the "legacy Admin UI" docs into the React Dashboard.
- Upgrade `@vendure/*` packages piecemeal — they are always upgraded together, to the same version.

## 12. Project-specific notes & known deviations (don't copy these patterns)

- **`backend/patches/@vendure+dashboard+3.7.3.patch`** (patch-package) removes the "Explore
  Platform & Cloud" link from the Dashboard user menu (`nav-user.tsx`). It is tied to the exact
  version and **will fail on the next upgrade** — regenerate it: edit the file in
  `node_modules`, then `npx patch-package @vendure/dashboard` (restore the pristine
  `lingui.config.js` and remove `src/i18n/locales/el.po` from the package first, otherwise the
  Greek setup files end up in the patch).
- **`scripts/setup-greek-translations.js`** copies `backend/lingui.config.js` and
  `src/plugins/greek-translations/dashboard/el.po` into `node_modules/@vendure/dashboard` on
  every install. The docs confirm a plugin cannot add a new Dashboard UI language, so this is
  still needed. `backend/lingui.config.js` is the 3.7.3 upstream config + `'el'` — re-sync it on
  every Dashboard upgrade. Strings added after 3.5.3 show in English until added to `el.po`.
- `search/b2b-search-strategy.ts` subclasses Vendure's **internal** `PostgresSearchStrategy`
  via `require('@vendure/core/dist/...')` and re-implements the private `applyTermAndFilters`
  (currently mirroring 3.7.3 + the partial-SKU `ILIKE`). On every upgrade, diff it against the
  new core file and re-test that searching "1034" finds SKU "A1034…".
- **Customer approval invariants** (customer-approval plugin): `approved === true` ⇔ admin
  approved. Approve also sets `user.verified = true`; revoke sets it back to `false` and deletes
  the customer's sessions, so pending customers get `NotVerifiedError` at login (the storefront
  shows "wait for admin verification"). Never re-enable the `emailVerificationHandler`, and never
  make `approved` writable through the API. Unapproved customers cannot complete a password reset.
- **CSV import** runs on the worker: in dev the worker is started by `npm run dev:server`; in
  production the worker process must be deployed too, or imports stay PENDING. New products use
  the shared option groups `color` / `characteristic`; products imported before Sept 2026 keep
  their per-product `color-<code>` groups (still recognised). SKU format:
  `<code>-<color>-<characteristic>` — changing it breaks re-import matching.
- `vatNumber` / `company` are intentionally editable by customers (storefront profile page).
- Only `dummyPaymentHandler` is configured — don't ship to production without a real
  payment method (e.g. invoice/bank-transfer handler, see skill backend §9).
- `README.md` mentions Meilisearch, but Vendure currently uses the Postgres search strategy.
- Secrets live in `.env` / `.env.local` (git-ignored). Never print, copy or commit their values.
